references.text: Moses tells about the manna that was given to the Israelites in the wilderness, which can be seen as a precursor to the miracle Jesus performs.
This verse describes a similar miracle performed by Jesus, where he feeds a large crowd with few loaves of bread.
Luke's version of the event where Jesus feeds five thousand men, referring to the same miracle.
John gives a detailed description of how Jesus feeds five thousand men with bread, which is directly related to the event in Mark.
